title: Recover real compact inertia and the sharp-order quantum locking resource
statement: The finite periodic helical rotor has 1/B_eff=f/B0+(1-f)/B with f=(2pi)^2/(integral psi0^2 integral psi0^-2). B_eff>=cB forces U_bar>=E_R/(4pi^2) log_+^2[c(R-1)/(1-c)]. The explicit V_b=E_R[b^2 sin^2 psi+b(1-cos psi)] has psi_b proportional to exp(b cos psi), f=I0(2b)^-2 and attains the E_R log^2 R order.

requires: A finite smooth bounded periodic scalar lock on R x S1, positive actual B0,I, real g and the actual zero-flux rotor ground state.
provides: The finite periodic helical rotor has 1/B_eff=f/B0+(1-f)/B with f=(2pi)^2/(integral psi0^2 integral psi0^-2). B_eff>=cB forces U_bar>=E_R/(4pi^2) log_+^2[c(R-1)/(1-c)]. The explicit V_b=E_R[b^2 sin^2 psi+b(1-cos psi)] has psi_b proportional to exp(b cos psi), f=I0(2b)^-2 and attains the E_R log^2 R order.
assumptions: Ground-band second derivative is the returned response. Hard constraints, hard stops and other topology are outside the periodic-lock obstruction. No heat or material realization follows.
costs: Count all translating mass and I<=m_r R_r^2. At fixed I, growing gain pays recoil, barrier, peak force/curvature and shrinking pitch; large-I/fixed-g is a different extent tradeoff.
contract.units: R=B/B0,f,b,c are dimensionless; E_R=hbar^2 B/(2B0 I) and U_bar are energies; g is inverse length.
contract.obstruction: An ideal geometric gain or local angle gap is insufficient: actual winding dispersion must be suppressed to order1/R.

body: Complete the actual pY,L square using conserved P=pY+gL. The phase-twist minimizer fixes the reciprocal-density stiffness. Riccati extrema bound the log ground-density ratio and hence f below. Direct substitution of the positive no-node exp(b cos) state supplies the matching construction. With fixed barrier and fixed I,B0, growing g instead makes f tend to1 and B_eff tend to B0. This is a full periodic-rotor response theorem, not a harmonic or ideal no-slip constraint.
